theme: An open Dubrovnik day, with dry-land prep due before Saturday's charter.
greeting: The calendar is empty in Dubrovnik, Dan, so the day is yours. The one thing worth spending it on is the prep that has to happen before you board the Nautilus Saturday, when connectivity goes dark.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Nautilus boarding and return transfer
needsAttention.detail: You board Sat Sep 12 (~5 PM), but the instructor still needs to confirm the exact time and location, and the airport transfer for disembarking Sep 19 should be arranged now. Charter connectivity is poor once underway, so this is a dry-land job.

needsAttention.title: Close the Cavtat Sep 19 loose ends
needsAttention.detail: Hotel Epidaurus is booked, but the Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer, an early-afternoon bag hold, and the ~5:15 AM Sep 20 checkout and airport taxi all still need arranging from shore before you board.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sep 20-Oct 5 rental car outright
needsAttention.detail: No longer a hedge: the Pathfinder is being driven down later, so a Full Size SUV out of TPA for Sep 20-Oct 5 needs booking now, refundable if possible. You land TPA jet-lagged on a Sunday and shouldn't arrive without a car.

needsAttention.title: Cover the Sep 20-22 St Pete gap
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sun Sep 20 but the kids aren't picked up until Tue Sep 22, leaving two unbooked nights near St Pete. Also worth confirming the Sep 27-Oct 5 St Pete Airbnb converted from pending to confirmed.

flagged.title: Nomura intro call still pending with Mike Lubrano
flagged.detail: The Valoris/Nomura networking thread is warm: Mike wants to schedule a call and floated a real project for Nomura. Nothing owed today, but worth a reply once you're back on solid connectivity.

inbox.noise: The rest of the inbox is retail and newsletters: Indochino, Chairish, NYT Cooking, Rocco Forte, Midcoast Villager.
inbox.clear: Nothing security, account, or financial needs you this morning.

recipe.title: Grilled quail with braised chestnuts & kabocha squash
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first chestnuts and winter squash to the market — a dish that leans into the turn toward cooler evenings.

tasks.title: Confirm Nautilus boarding time and return transfer
Close Cavtat Sep 19 transfers and early checkout
Book St Pete lodging for the Sep 20-22 gap

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar in Dubrovnik, so the morning is entirely open.
Best spent on the shore prep: nail down the Nautilus boarding details and the Cavtat transfers while you still have signal.
An easy night before Saturday's charter, with the girls over with Jen this stretch.
